assertions.claim: Without surgery, medication-only mortality for type A aortic dissection is 58%; in-hospital mortality overall 27.4% (IRAD, 12 centers, 464 cases).
assertions.cn_span: 这病不手术、光用药的死亡率 58%

assertions.claim: Management is the opposite of myocardial infarction — a doctor who thinks of it orders contrast CT instead of anticoagulation/thrombolysis.
Large blood-pressure difference between arms or an unpalpable pulse on one side should also be reported.
assertions.cn_span: 两条胳膊血压差很多、一侧摸不到脉，也一起说出来

assertions.claim: Higher risk with poorly controlled hypertension, Marfan syndrome, family history of aneurysm/dissection; don't drive, don't endure until tomorrow.
assertions.cn_span: 高血压控制不好、马凡综合征、有主动脉瘤或夹层家族史的人风险高
